text: Machine learning allows computers to learn from data without being explicitly programmed. In supervised learning, a model is trained using labelled examples called training data. During this process, the model finds patterns that connect inputs to the correct outputs. Once training is complete, the model can make predictions about new, unseen data. The quality of these predictions is measured by accuracy, which shows how often the model is correct. Good training data is essential, because a model can only learn from the examples it receives. Machine learning is now used in many everyday applications, from recommendations to spam filters.
